csv_project_name: Engineering for WSF Dormitories Level I & Level II
csv_scope_of_work: Architects and engineers for the Wyoming State Fair Dormitories Level I and Level II Studies at the Wyoming State Fair in Douglas, WY. The successful professional service provider will be responsible for the Level I and Level II studies for the Fort Bridger, Fort Laramie, and Fort Bonneville dormitories. A most cost-effective remedy approach will be conducted in consultation with the Wyoming State Fair s needs to determine the best approach forward for maintenance and rehabilitation of the three dormitory buildings. Cost estimating services will be incorporated in to this work.
csv_disciplines_requested: Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Cost Estimating

title: Engineering for WSF Dormitories Level I & Level II
short_description: Studies for maintenance and rehabilitation of three Wyoming State Fair dormitory buildings.
project_scope: Level I and Level II studies for the Fort Bridger, Fort Laramie, and Fort Bonneville dormitories at the Wyoming State Fair in Douglas, Wyoming. The assignment includes assessing the three existing dormitory buildings, developing the most cost-effective remedy approach, and determining the best path forward for maintenance and rehabilitation.
services: Architectural and engineering services for rehabilitation and refurbishment studies, including civil engineering and cost estimating.
relevance_explanation:
- Existing dormitory rehabilitation study for three buildings, not a structurally distinctive or long-span project.
- Building type is university/state fair dormitories, which is less aligned with sbp's core focus than bridges, roofs, stadiums, or special structures.
- Scope is limited to Level I and Level II studies and cost estimating, so the planning depth appears early-stage and strategic rather than detailed structural design.
- Could offer some relevance through rehabilitation and engineering input, but overall fit is moderate to low.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the tender notice. The scope covers Level I and Level II studies, maintenance and rehabilitation strategy, and cost estimating for three existing dormitory buildings, but no size, area, or rehabilitation extent is provided, so a realistic construction cost estimate is not possible from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the tender notice. Only study, rehabilitation assessment, and cost estimating services are mentioned, without budget, fee basis, or scope breakdown, so no realistic fee estimate is possible.
references_qualifications: Professional service provider with architectural/engineering capability for rehabilitation and refurbishment studies; civil engineering and cost estimating disciplines requested. No specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the notice excerpt.
contracting_authority: Wyoming State Construction Department, Douglas, Wyoming, USA. Contact: Ryan Scranton. Phone: 307-777-5945. Email: ryan.scranton@wyo.gov. Website: https://www.publicpurchase.com/gems/wyoconstruction,wy/bid/bidView?bidId=212354
notes: Project number: 26-0648. Questions deadline: 2026-05-28 05:00 PM MDT. Target market listed as Universities/Colleges. The notice refers to Wyoming State Fair dormitories and requests Level I and Level II studies for three named dormitory buildings.
